University affiliation

SVS Medical College is affiliated to Kaloji Narayana Rao University of Health Sciences (KNRUHS), Warangal, Telangana. University statutes, applicable government orders, examination ordinances and admission-batch regulations govern studentship.

Communication and representation

Route routine university correspondence, leave applications and representations through the Principal so that the college can process and forward them. This administrative route does not replace statutory complaint, safeguarding, emergency or regulatory reporting channels.

Discipline and conduct

The institutional conduct policy addresses strikes, agitations, demonstrations and boycotts of academic sessions, together with public statements concerning the institution, university or government. Obtain the current approved policy from the college office for the exact terms and procedures.

Misconduct and falsification of documents may lead to disciplinary investigation and action, including cancellation of admission where authorised by the applicable rules, following notice and due process. Students may use the appropriate grievance and appeal procedures.

Break of study and termination of studentship

For continuous absence of 91 days or more, apply in the prescribed format through the Principal to the Registrar for the Vice-Chancellor’s approval. Any extension of the study period is governed by the approved break-of-study order.

The stated studentship policy provides for forfeiture where continuous or cumulative absence exceeds two years. Confirm how absence, approval, readmission and notice provisions apply to the individual case with the academic office.

Course completion is subject to the applicable university and NMC time limits. Refer to the MBBS eligibility and progression rules for the admission-batch requirements.

Discontinuation and bond liability

Withdrawal after the notified counselling cut-off may attract the applicable discontinuation bond and debarment provisions. KNRUHS’s 2025–26 counselling notices specify a ₹20,00,000 discontinuation penalty and three-year debarment in the stated circumstances after the mop-up/stray-vacancy phase. Check the notice and prospectus for your admission year and quota.

The prescribed bond uses ₹100 non-judicial stamp paper, with execution requirements set out in the applicable proforma. Government Orders 125, 126 and 127 and any later amendments must be checked before signing or withdrawing. Contact the admissions office for the current form and terms.
